name: mutuAl understandIng
source:
A lonely office worker searches for love at her local café. What happens next may surprise you.

[From [url=https://ceoofbadart.itch.io/mutual-understanding]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名孤獨的上班族在住處附近的咖啡館裡尋找愛情。接下來發生的事，也許會讓你吃一驚。
